bio: Pieter-Jan Rombaux and his wife, Tineke, do everything themselves and the focus is clearly home-made. She nurtures the cheerful, unstuffy vibe, while he rustles up dishes that seek to enhance the ingredient’s pure flavours with perfect seasonings. Take a seat on the secluded terrace to admire the chef at work in the kitchen. Rather than gimmicky surprises, you can look forward to heart-warming dishes such as foie gras with brioche or hanger steak with a red-wine sauce to die for....
